rubric.LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Seamless integration with OpenAI's API; well-crafted prompts ensure accurate and engaging responses. Handles various query types effectively.
rubric.Retrieval & Search Efficiency: Efficiently retrieves the most relevant movie data using FAISS/vector search. Handles both title-based and descriptive queries accurately.
rubric.Conversational Flow & Query Handling: Supports multi-turn conversations, follow-up queries, and context retention. Adapts to user input dynamically and refines responses.
rubric.Movie Data Representation & Formatting: Displays movie details (title, genre, actors, ratings, descriptions) in a structured and user-friendly manner. Uses markdown formatting or a clean UI.
rubric.Handling of Edge Cases & Error Responses: Gracefully handles invalid inputs, typos, or unsupported queries with informative messages instead of failing.
rubric.User Interface & Deployment (Gradio/Stre: Intuitive, well-designed chatbot interface with smooth interaction. Fast response times, clear buttons, and efficient user experience.
rubric.Code Structure & Documentation: Clean, modular code with clear function descriptions, comments, and well-organized notebook sections. Easy to understand and extend.
rubric.Creativity & Feature Enhancement: Implements advanced features like multi-agent workflows (e.g., separate agents for movie search, review analysis, and genre-based recommendations), trending movie suggestions, interactive quizzes, voice-based search, or multimodal input (text + images/video trailers). Enhances chatbot interactivity beyond simple queries.
